A thick, continuous low-intensity black band follows the trailing edge and lateral margins. Dense, localized low-intensity linear streaks (raking) are distributed across the surface, with higher density in the mid-right lobe (viewer perspective).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave sweep trailing from the median notch toward the distal tips, transitioning to a convex curve at the outermost lateral edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, circular pixel mounds (barnacle colonization) are clearly visible on the distal-most tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the white medial surface; particularly dense vertical and diagonal scarring on the right lobe (viewer right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant jagged notch/irregular excision is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer left) near the distal tip. Extensive multi-directional rake marks cover roughly 30% of the visible ventral surface.
